levels.name: Syracuse · Salt Yard
levels.description: A dense downtown approach built around Clinton Square and the old canal corridor.

cells.name: Clinton Square
cells.notes: Primary arrival cell and Rowan encounter space.

cells.name: Clinton Provisioners
cells.notes: Locked shop interior with searchable stock cage.

npcs.name: Rowan Vale
npcs.personality: Wary, dryly funny, practical, private, and slow to trust.
npcs.dialogueStyle: Short, observant sentences. Deflects with questions when motives are unclear.
npcs.motivation: Map a survivable western route without owing Albany a favor.
npcs.fears: Becoming responsible for another doomed traveler.

quests.title: The Courthouse Ledger
quests.summary: Follow Rowan's rumor to a pre-Silence ledger beneath the courthouse.
quests.completionRequirements: The Courier possesses continuity-ledger and has not surrendered it to another faction.
